description: Import a HyperFrames project (HeyGen's HTML-to-video format) into the attached tab: `path` is its folder (index.html at the top) or a .zip of it. The whole project becomes one code layer — nested data-composition-src files, pictures, videos, fonts and stylesheets embedded, HyperFrames' runtime driven by the playhead — and each <audio> clip a sound layer at its start. Then look at it with frames, and finish it by hand or with run_tool.
name: import_hyperframes
